note: JARVIS's SQLite schema as it stood when the records moved into the engine (round 3 of docs/planning/knowledge-engine/plan-uds.md), and each store's schema version; export-sqlite builds a file with it when the engine holds no move manifest (an install that never had jarvis.db).

objects.name: runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE runs (
                id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                project_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
                project_path  TEXT NOT NULL,
                prompt        TEXT NOT NULL,
                origin        TEXT NOT NULL,
                status        TEXT NOT NULL,
                resume_from   TEXT,
                result_text   TEXT DEFAULT '',
                summary       TEXT DEFAULT '',
                error         TEXT DEFAULT '',
                exit_code     INTEGER,
                pid           INTEGER,
                cost_usd      REAL    DEFAULT 0,
                input_tokens  INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                output_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                cache_read_tokens     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                cache_creation_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                num_turns     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                model         TEXT DEFAULT '',
                requested_model TEXT DEFAULT '',
                is_error      INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
                created_at    REAL NOT NULL,
                started_at    REAL,
                ended_at      REAL
            , folder_id TEXT, package_id TEXT, context_sha256 TEXT, project_id TEXT, work_id TEXT)

objects.name: messages
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
                id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                session_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
                provider      TEXT NOT NULL,          -- "anthropic", "openai"
                agent_name    TEXT NOT NULL,          -- the name it was sent under
                project       TEXT NOT NULL,
                capture_id    INTEGER,                -- the capture it came from
                text          TEXT NOT NULL,          -- exactly what was sent
                status        TEXT NOT NULL,          -- see MessageStatus
                staged_at     REAL NOT NULL,
                sent_at       REAL,
                delivered_at  REAL,                   -- seen in the session's transcript
                started_at    REAL,                   -- the session's turn on it began
                answered_at   REAL,                   -- that turn ended
                reply         TEXT,                   -- the turn's final answer, as said
                failure       TEXT                    -- why, when status is failed
            )

        ON package_inbox_events (inbox_id, seq)

objects.name: project_schema
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE project_schema (version INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: projects
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE projects (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    owner_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    node_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    display_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
    spoken_key    TEXT NOT NULL,
    notes_slug    TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    lifecycle     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (lifecycle IN ('active', 'paused', 'done', 'archived')),
    revision      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at    REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at    REAL NOT NULL,
    archived_at   REAL
)

objects.name: projects_by_spoken_key
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX projects_by_spoken_key
    ON projects (owner_id, spoken_key) WHERE lifecycle <> 'archived'

objects.name: project_aliases
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_aliases (
    owner_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    source      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN (
                    'spoken', 'session_project', 'run_project', 'workflow_project',
                    'message_project', 'memory_slug', 'projects_root')),
    alias_key   TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    added_at    REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (owner_id, source, alias_key)
)

objects.name: project_aliases_by_project
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX project_aliases_by_project ON project_aliases (project_id)

objects.name: project_folders
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_folders (
    project_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    folder_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
    part        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (part IN ('source', 'docs', 'data', 'output', 'reference')),
    is_home     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    index_scope TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'docs' CHECK (index_scope IN ('docs', 'text', 'off')),
    revision    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    added_at    REAL NOT NULL,
    removed_at  REAL,
    PRIMARY KEY (project_id, folder_id, added_at)
)

objects.name: project_folders_live
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX project_folders_live
    ON project_folders (project_id, folder_id) WHERE removed_at IS NULL

objects.name: project_folders_one_home
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX project_folders_one_home
    ON project_folders (project_id) WHERE is_home = 1 AND removed_at IS NULL

objects.name: project_folders_by_folder
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX project_folders_by_folder
    ON project_folders (folder_id) WHERE removed_at IS NULL

objects.name: project_candidates
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_candidates (
    id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    owner_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    proposed_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence       TEXT NOT NULL,
    fingerprint    TEXT NOT NULL,
    state          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('proposed', 'ignored', 'accepted')),
    project_id     TEXT REFERENCES projects(id),
    created_at     REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at     REAL NOT NULL
)

objects.name: project_candidates_by_key
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX project_candidates_by_key ON project_candidates (owner_id, proposed_name)

objects.name: works
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE works (
    id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    owner_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    title       TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    state       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open', 'done', 'dropped')),
    origin      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('local', 'received')),
    revision    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at  REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at  REAL NOT NULL,
    closed_at   REAL
)

objects.name: work_projects
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE work_projects (
    work_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES works(id),
    project_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    role        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('primary', 'involved')),
    added_at    REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (work_id, project_id)
)

objects.name: work_projects_one_primary
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX work_projects_one_primary
    ON work_projects (work_id) WHERE role = 'primary'

objects.name: work_folders
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE work_folders (
    work_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES works(id),
    folder_id  TEXT NOT NULL,
    added_at   REAL NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (work_id, folder_id)
)

objects.name: accomplishments
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE accomplishments (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    work_id       TEXT REFERENCES works(id),
    title         TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    state         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('proposed', 'confirmed', 'withdrawn')),
    proposed_by   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (proposed_by IN (
                      'page', 'voice', 'run_finish', 'workflow_finish', 'merge', 'package_result', 'import')),
    achieved_at   REAL NOT NULL,
    confirmed_at  REAL,
    revision      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at    REAL NOT NULL
)

objects.name: accomplishments_by_project
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX accomplishments_by_project ON accomplishments (project_id, state, achieved_at)

objects.name: accomplishment_evidence
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE accomplishment_evidence (
    accomplishment_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accomplishments(id),
    ref                TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (accomplishment_id, ref)
)

objects.name: project_bindings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_bindings (
    subject     TEXT NOT NULL,
    project_id  TEXT REFERENCES projects(id),
    work_id     TEXT REFERENCES works(id),
    folder_id   TEXT,
    how         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (how IN ('started_here', 'owner', 'adopted')),
    bound_at    REAL NOT NULL,
    unbound_at  REAL,
    CHECK (project_id IS NOT NULL OR work_id IS NOT NULL)
)

objects.name: project_bindings_live
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX project_bindings_live
    ON project_bindings (subject, IFNULL(project_id, ''), IFNULL(work_id, '')) WHERE unbound_at IS NULL

objects.name: project_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_events (
    seq       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    at        REAL NOT NULL,
    subject   TEXT NOT NULL,
    action    TEXT NOT NULL,
    revision  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    actor     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor IN ('page', 'voice', 'agent', 'migration', 'package')),
    detail    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
)

objects.name: project_events_by_subject
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX project_events_by_subject ON project_events (subject, seq)

objects.name: needs_board_writers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE needs_board_writers (
                project      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  -- the board's file stem
                mtime        REAL NOT NULL,
                session_id   TEXT NOT NULL,     -- the listed agent's session
                name         TEXT NOT NULL,     -- as shown: "Feynman (Planning)" for a subagent
                evidence     TEXT NOT NULL,
                subagent     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
            )

objects.name: conversation_schema
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE conversation_schema (version INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: conversation_items_by_counterpart
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX conversation_items_by_counterpart
        ON conversation_items (counterpart_kind, counterpart_ref, id)

objects.name: conversation_items_once_per_source
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX conversation_items_once_per_source
        ON conversation_items (kind, source_kind, source_id)
        WHERE source_kind IS NOT NULL AND kind = 'message_in'

objects.name: agent_keys_schema
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE agent_keys_schema (version INTEGER NOT NULL)

objects.name: agent_keys
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_keys (
        fingerprint   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        public_key    TEXT NOT NULL,
        principal     TEXT NOT NULL,
        session_id    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        provider      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        state         TEXT NOT NULL,
        submitted_at  REAL NOT NULL,
        proven_at     REAL,
        proven_by     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        onboarded_at  REAL,
        onboarded_by  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        revoked_at    REAL,
        revoked_by    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        revoked_why   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        label         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        work_id       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        issued_by     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        expires_at    REAL
    )

objects.name: agent_keys_session
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX agent_keys_session ON agent_keys(session_id, state)

objects.name: agent_rights
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_rights (
        principal   TEXT NOT NULL,
        "right"     TEXT NOT NULL,
        scope       TEXT NOT NULL,
        granted_at  REAL NOT NULL,
        granted_by  TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (principal, "right", scope)
    )

objects.name: agent_key_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_key_events (

    )

objects.name: legacy_admissions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE legacy_admissions (

        label  TEXT NOT NULL,
        count  INTEGER NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (day, label)
    )

objects.name: agent_key_held
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_key_held (
        id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        subject        TEXT NOT NULL,
        fingerprint    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        session_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        kind           TEXT NOT NULL,
        what           TEXT NOT NULL,
        path           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        detail         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        work_id        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        held_at        REAL NOT NULL,
        state          TEXT NOT NULL,
        settled_at     REAL
    )

objects.name: agent_key_held_subject
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX agent_key_held_subject ON agent_key_held(subject, state)

objects.name: agent_key_errors
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_key_errors (
        subject        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        package_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        inbox_id       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        made_at        REAL NOT NULL
    )

objects.name: agent_key_settings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_key_settings (
        name   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value  TEXT NOT NULL,
        at     REAL NOT NULL
    )

objects.name: conversation_items_by_source
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX conversation_items_by_source
        ON conversation_items (source_kind, source_id, id)

objects.name: agent_author_proofs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_author_proofs (

        package_sha  TEXT NOT NULL,
        bound_at     REAL NOT NULL
    )
